data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'aqdasa' meaning 'most exalted, honored one'. This name reflects the deep reverence and respect given to the one bearing it, symbolizing their status as a beloved and cherished member of the Islamic community. The name Aqdasah carries the meaning “Most Exalted, Honored One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aqdasah usually hope their child will grow to embody most exalted, honored one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
